# Connector Readiness Audit

Agentic research over 100 SaaS apps for Composio toolkit buildability, with a prioritized build-and-outreach queue and honest, gold-scored accuracy.

Status: partial (90/100) (run run-100).

## Headline
- 90 apps audited; 46 already Composio toolkits (lower bound (partial catalog source)).
- 68 can ship this week with zero approvals.
- 3 need outreach/approval — start those now (long lead times).
- 0 are not toolkits (no API / wrong shape).
- 9 routed to human review; 52 have first-party MCP.
